notes.title: New Upgrades & Game Balance!
notes.content:
Hi! Two new upgrades have been added.

[b]Upgrades[/b]

1 - Every 12 seconds throw projectiles spending 10 of energy.
2 - Increase pickup range.

Before there was no good way to deal with hordes of enemies, now you have a chance >:)


[b]Game balance[/b]

Now every level up until level 20 adds some upgrades:

- level 2 = +1 Enemy
- level 3 = +1 Star
- level 4 = +1 Enemy
- level 5 = +1 Star
- level 6 = +1 Enemy
- level 7 = +1 Star
- level 8 = +1 Enemy
- level 9 = +1 Star
- level 10 = +25 Maximum energy & +4 Pickup range & +4 Projectiles
- level 12 = +1 Star
- level 14 = +1 Enemy
- level 16 = +1 Enemy
- level 18 = + Star
- level 20 = +25 Maximum energy & +4 Pickup range & +4 Projectiles

[strike]-------------------------------------------------------------------------[/strike]

Before the worm's length was increased per level, now every 4 level up the size is increased.

notes.title: 👾 New Bugs! 👾
notes.content:
That's right! two bugs with unique mechanics have been added!

[list]

[*] pink bug - stands still and spawn little bugs to attack you.
[/list]

notes.title: 🪱 Hello, Worms! 🪱
notes.content:
[h1] Hi! spaceworm is released! [/h1]

spaceworm is a casual game each match takes 1 minute longer. [b]( this is very relative 🥴 )[/b]
your goal is eat the maximal of stars, planets and enemies until DIE!


[h2]Default & Upgrades[/h2]

each upgrades increases a value.

[b]enemies[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EdAIbFV.png[/img]

- default: 0
- upgrade: add +1 to range.

[b]star & planet[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dXd2Djd.png[/img]

- default:
[i]xp_range[/i] = 5
[i]quantity[/i] = 5
[i]planet_xp_range[/i] = xp_range * 4
[i]planet_quantity[/i] = quantity / 5

- upgrade:
[i]xp_range[/i] = add +1
[i]quantity[/i] = add +2

[b]timeout[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BH44uX8.png[/img]

- default:
[i]enemies_timeout[/i] = 12
[i]food_timeout[/i] = 6

- upgrade: add -0.5

[b]energy[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/on9Zzp2.png[/img]

- default: 20
- upgrade: add +5

[b]energy regeneration[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rFHbAQM.png[/img]

- default: 1
- upgrade: add -0.05

[b]life[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/R1kYxgL.png[/img]

- default: 3
- upgrade: add +1 if life < 3

[b]attack length[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uGNegN3.png[/img]

- default: 0
- upgrade: add +1

[b]random[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pGhaXJC.png[/img]
